items.title: Workflow pipeline replaces the three virtue tiles
items.precondition: Dev server on http://localhost:5170, desktop viewport
steps: 1. Scroll to the 'Speed with structure' dark slab
items.expected: Five numbered stages (Explore, Plan, Execute, Verify, Finalize) with command chips replace Speed/Structure/Accountability; provenance line and both action buttons render; 'Code Constitution available on request' note present; CTA intact

items.title: Workflow modal opens, explains commands + Constitution, closes accessibly
steps: 2. Inspect content: provenance intro, 12-command reference, contract section, Constitution summary, download button
items.expected: Modal opens with role=dialog and locked body scroll; contains command gate reference and §N.M Constitution summary; closes on Esc and backdrop click, restoring scroll
items.evidence: evidence/workflow-modal.png; DOM checks: modalOpen/bodyLocked/hasConstitution true; escClosed/backdropClosed/bodyUnlocked true

items.title: AGENTS.md downloads and is company-neutral
items.expected: 200 response; no matches for alloro/laggy/friyay/client names; document covers command gate, plan artifacts, acceptance, risk levels, verification pipeline, Constitution pairing note
items.evidence: fetch returned status 200, 10969 bytes, scrubOk: true; repo-side grep clean
items.notes: Constitution intentionally not downloadable — offered on request, tailored per stack

items.title: Build gates clean
